borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
description: Non-material amendments to planning permission reference: 2024/02631/FUL dated 7th May 2025 for the "Erection of a front roof extension; erection of a rear extension at second floor level over part of the existing back addition; erection of a single storey side and rear extension following the demolition of the existing rear extension; installation of new rooflight above the main flat roof at roof level and above the roof of second floor rear back addition; infilling of the existing rooflights and installation of French doors and a Juliet balcony in the rear roofslope; de-conversion of the existing building from 2no self-contained flats into a single family dwellinghouse."  Amendments sought are slight changes in location and size of windows, removal of flat roof skylight above sceond floor rear back addition, and addition of lantern rooflight above side extension.
